name: Novel object recognition test
description: After a familiarization trial with two identical objects, the animal is tested with one familiar and one novel object. Assesses recognition memory: an animal that remembers the familiar object spends more time exploring the novel one.

parameters.label: Arena width
parameters.help: Internal width of the arena floor, measured wall to wall along the horizontal axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Arena depth
parameters.help: Internal depth of the arena floor, measured wall to wall along the vertical axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Minimum exploration bout
parameters.help: A visit to an object's zone counts as exploration only when the subject stays in the zone at least this long; shorter passes are ignored.

parameters.label: Minimum total exploration time
parameters.help: No discrimination index is computed for subjects whose combined exploration of both objects falls below this value. Set to 0 to disable the criterion.

parameters.label: Maximum tracking gap
parameters.help: Longest tracking dropout that is bridged; movement across a longer gap is excluded. Increase only for low-frame-rate videos.

zones.label: Novel object
zones.geometry: Drawn on the calibration around the novel object, enclosing the object's footprint plus the exploration distance (about 2 cm). One circle or polygon.

zones.label: Familiar object
zones.geometry: Drawn on the calibration around the familiar object, enclosing the object's footprint plus the exploration distance (about 2 cm). One circle or polygon.

events.label: Object exploration
events.definition: An exploration bout is a run of contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample lies in the object's zone and that lasts at least min_bout_s; shorter visits are not exploration. The label names the object: novel or familiar. Exploration is approximated by the body center in the zone, so sitting on the object counts too.

metrics.label: Novel object exploration time
metrics.description: Time spent exploring the novel object.
metrics.definition: Coordinates are in centimeters in the calibration's arena frame: origin at a corner of the arena floor, x to the right and y down the image. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples separated by 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s. Total length of the novel object's exploration bouts.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Familiar object exploration time
metrics.description: Time spent exploring the familiar object.
metrics.definition: Total length of the familiar object's exploration bouts.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Total exploration time
metrics.description: Time spent exploring either object; very low values make the discrimination index unreliable.
metrics.definition: Sum of the novel and familiar object exploration times.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.

metrics.label: Discrimination index
metrics.description: Preference for the novel object, from -1 to +1. Positive values indicate that the familiar object is remembered; values near 0 indicate no preference.
metrics.definition: Relative exploration of the novel object, from -1 (familiar object only) to +1 (novel object only).
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals, (BELOW_EXPLORATION_CRITERION) when total exploration time is below min_total_exploration_s, and (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when it is 0.
